name: Ruins of Mathystra
summary: Stormscale naga guard Mathystra's broken halls along Darkshore's northern coast. Ghost Sabers stalk the ruins of the ancient night elven city, shattered during the Great Sundering ten thousand years ago.

sections.title: A City Cast into the Sea
sections.body: Mathystra once housed high-ranking Highborne nobility on Darkshore's northern coast. When the Well of Eternity collapsed during the Great Sundering, great waves shattered the city, toppled its marble arches, and swept much of its stonework into the sea. The surviving night elves left for smaller woodland villages farther south. Sunken courtyards and cracked foundations remain, battered by the coast.

sections.title: The Stormscale Vipers and Ghost Sabers
sections.body: Stormscale naga guard Mathystra's broken halls, driving away travelers who venture north past the Tower of Althalaxx. Ancient Highborne relics lie half-buried among the flagstones, sand, and seafoam. Young night elves sometimes brave the naga to recover remnants of their heritage, while spectral Ghost Sabers stalk the broken streets.

faq.q: What used to be here before the ruins?
faq.answer: Mathystra was a thriving night elven city built during the height of the ancient Highborne empire. The Well of Eternity's collapse during the Great Sundering shattered the city and drowned much of it ten thousand years ago, cleaving Kalimdor apart.

faq.q: Who controls the Ruins of Mathystra right now?
faq.answer: Stormscale naga occupy the ruins, emerging from the sea to claim the sunken pavilions and coastlines. They attack land-dwellers who enter their territory.

Ghost Sabers are ethereal, translucent felines that haunt Mathystra's ruined stonework. Hunters seek them along the coast, and disturbing ancient figurines in the area can draw the spirits from the shadows.

faq.q: Why do night elves visit these ruins today?
faq.answer: Young night elves and scholars sometimes enter the ruins to recover Highborne relics left behind after the Sundering. Stormscale naga make the search perilous.

angles.text: Mathystra recalls the hubris of the ancient Highborne, whose reckless sorcery brought cataclysm upon their coastal settlements.
Ghost Sabers prowl Mathystra's rubble as translucent beasts with ties to the spirit world, sought by beastmasters looking for a striking companion.
